g.text: Fig. 9. Fruit yield, TRAIN. (a) Study aggregates (rho = 0.5 within study, compound symmetry); square size = rma.mv weight; bar at the bottom = pooled
95 % CR2 CI. (b) Subgroup means (levels with < 4 studies pooled as "other"), robust CR2 CIs and HTZ Wald p. Variances: author SD where reported,
otherwise imputed with the mean CV (Nakagawa et al. 2023) - imputed variances are not author-reported. [V5 (2026-11-20)]
